steps.title: Analyze background audio playback failure causes

steps.title: Add WAKE_LOCK permission
steps.description: Declare android.permission.WAKE_LOCK in AndroidManifest.xml to keep CPU active during background playback.

steps.title: Implement PowerManager WakeLock in BackgroundAudioService
steps.description: Acquire PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK when background media service starts to prevent CPU sleep during audio playback.

steps.title: Create Page Visibility API JS override helper
steps.description: Develop JavaScript injection routine that overrides document.hidden and suppresses visibilitychange events.

steps.title: Inject JS override into WebView lifecycle hooks
steps.description: Execute JavaScript override on page load, pause, and stop events to keep YouTube HTML5 player active.

steps.title: Prevent premature WebView lifecycle pausing
steps.description: Ensure onPause and onStop methods in MainActivity do not destroy or pause the WebView instance.

steps.title: Maintain audio focus and background notification
steps.description: Verify BackgroundAudioService retains media playback focus and active foreground service notification.

steps.title: Verify watch history database recording
steps.description: Confirm SQLite watch history storage operates without interfering with background playback.

steps.title: Verify toolbar navigation and error state layout
steps.description: Check back, forward, refresh, home, and connection error handling views.

steps.title: Enforce Java 8 language compatibility
steps.description: Confirm source code uses traditional inner classes without Java 8+ lambdas.

steps.description: Check Gradle build configuration and target SDK version alignment.
